purpose: Teach: 精通/バネ/急上昇/弁理/全編/特段/ジャッジ/発進

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、海外市場に精通した社員を増やせ
lines.en: I want us to build up staff with real overseas market expertise.
lines.style: Clipped, direct opening. No warmth, but not harsh—authoritative clarity. Brief pause between statements. The tone of someone used to being listened to without repetition.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。バネのある若手も登用します
lines.en: Understood. We'll promote talented younger staff into those roles.
lines.style: Measured, professional affirmation. Slight upward lift on the verb—showing he's already thinking ahead. Steady eye contact level, no hesitation. The reply of someone taking notes mentally.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、急上昇した競合の研究をしろ
lines.en: And research the competition—the ones climbing fast. I want to know how.
lines.style: Sharper attack than before. Emphasis lands on 'fast' and 'how.' Leans forward slightly—this matters. Pace quickens. The tone of someone spotting a gap and filling it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。特許出願に弁理士を起用します
lines.en: Yes. I'll bring in a patent attorney to handle the applications.
lines.style: Nods internally while speaking. Concrete, solution-focused. No padding. Each phrase lands with quiet confidence. The voice of someone who knows what needs doing and already has the answer.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社史の全編を編纂しろ
lines.en: Compile the entire company history. Full documentation.
lines.style: Slower delivery on 'entire.' Weight on the scope. Not a suggestion—a mandate stated as fact. The pause before the second sentence shows this matters for reasons Kenji might not immediately understand.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。特段の事情がある社員は配慮します
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure we're considerate with any staff who have special circumstances.
lines.style: Thoughtful acknowledgment. Slight softening on 'considerate'—humanity breaking through protocol. Steady but gentle. The voice of someone who listens and translates the hard directive into something humane.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、人事のジャッジを公平にしろ
lines.en: HR decisions need to be fair across the board. No exceptions.
lines.style: Firm, final statement. 'Fair' gets emphasis—this is non-negotiable. Slight tension in the delivery, held tight. The tone of someone who has seen unfairness and won't tolerate it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新事業の発進を準備します
lines.en: Understood. I'll get the new business initiative ready to launch.
lines.style: Closing affirmation. Brisk, efficient. Light lift at the end—showing readiness and forward momentum. No hesitation, no excess. The voice of someone wrapping up and moving to action.
